semiconductor_relevance: High — Micron Star Technology Limited provides critical inspection and measurement tools for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Micron Star Technology Limited specializes in advanced inspection and measurement equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry, with a focus on nanometry applications. Their product offerings include Atomic Force Microscopes, Optical Microscopes, Scanning Electron Microscopes, and Focused Ion Beam systems, which are essential for quality control and defect detection in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Atomic Force Microscopes (AFM) for roughness and surface morphology analysis
Scanning Electron Microscopes (SEM) for detailed surface inspection
Focused Ion Beam (FIB) systems for precise material analysis
Optical Microscopes for general inspection tasks
